claims: Toyota is recalling over 550,000 Highlander and Highlander Hybrid SUVs (2021-2024 model years)
The recall is due to a second-row seat defect where the seat back may not lock
The second-row seat defect increases injury risks
Dealers will replace the return springs in the seat back recliner assemblies for free
Owners will be notified by mail starting in April 2026 for the latest recall
2021-2024 Highlander/Hybrid (March 2026): Second-row seat back may fail to lock, violating safety standards
2020-2023 Highlander (Oct 2023): Lower front bumper cover may detach, causing road hazards
2024 Grand Highlander (June 2024): Airbag might not deploy correctly if the driver's window is down
2017-2019 Highlander: Reports of 8-speed transmission issues, including whining noises and failure
Dealers will inspect, install retention hardware, or replace the front bumper cover for the bumper recall
This information is based on reports from March 2026, including data from MotorBiscuit, autoevolution, Fox Business, and USA Today
